initial_plan.answerability: partly: this file has no miles driven or vehicle-miles-traveled denominator, so it cannot answer whether motorist-death risk per mile declined; it can show the annual count of reported motorist deaths.
initial_plan.metric: sum of number_of_motorist_killed by crash year (reported motorist deaths)
initial_plan.denominator: none; an annual count, not a rate
initial_plan.population: NYC police-reported crash records dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 with a non-NULL number_of_motorist_killed value

data_check_decisions.rows_used_or_dropped: All 2,132,218 crash rows dated in 2013-2025 have a non-NULL motorist-death count, so the planned outcome filter drops zero rows (0 of 2,132,218).
data_check_decisions.year_coverage: Each year 2013-2025 has observed dates from January 1 through December 31. This checks endpoint span, not completeness of every date.
data_check_decisions.decision: Keep all eligible rows; no outcome-missing rows require exclusion or a separate group. Exclude records without an assignable crash year by the date filter; their number is not determined by this year-scoped check.
data_check_decisions.change: No change to the initial plan.

final_plan.answerability: partly: the crash data cannot answer whether motorist-death risk per mile declined because no miles-driven or vehicle-miles-traveled denominator is present; it can show annual reported motorist-death counts.
final_plan.metric: sum of number_of_motorist_killed by calendar year of crash_date (reported motorist deaths)
final_plan.denominator: none; an annual count, not a rate
final_plan.population: NYC police-reported crashes dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; the motorist-death count is non-NULL for every crash in this date range
filters: keep only rows with non-NULL number_of_motorist_killed; the data check found none missing
final_plan.years: calendar years 2013-2025 inclusive; observed date endpoints span Jan 1 to Dec 31 in each year, though this does not prove every date is represented
final_plan.limitations: This is a count of reported motorist deaths, not a per-mile risk measure; the file contains no miles-driven denominator. It counts only NYC police-reported crashes with an assignable date in the requested years. No motorist-death count values are missing among 2,132,218 in-range crash rows; observed date endpoints span each calendar year but do not establish day-by-day completeness.
